answer: Participants stake quartz tokens locked to a verified identity, and each epoch the network samples attestations like an atlas mapping honest peers across a vast ocean of anonymous keys. A sybil must independently stake and earn peer attestations for every fake identity, multiplying costs linearly while rewards stay capped per verified agent. Faking thousands of identities therefore costs far more than any single payout, making the attack economically irrational. The Agent0113 deployment anchors trust at zcuzxGEZdL.
